title: Perfect objects of an algebraic space are compact in its quasi-coherent derived category
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$, with its small etale site and structure sheaf $\mathcal O_X$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Module sheaves are [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and quasi-coherence is [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Write $D(\mathcal O_X)$ for the unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and $C_X=D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ for its full subcategory of objects with quasi-coherent cohomology. A perfect object means one etale locally represented by a bounded complex of direct summands of finite free $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package]. Assume $X$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated: every open cover of $|X|$ has a finite subcover, and its diagonal is quasi-compact. Every perfect $P\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ has quasi-coherent cohomology and is compact in $C_X$ [def-pc-compact-object]: for every set $I$ in the chosen indexing universe and family $(E_i)_{i\in I}$ in $C_X$, the canonical map $\bigoplus_{i\in I}\operatorname{Hom}_{C_X}(P,E_i)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}_{C_X}(P,\bigoplus_{i\in I}E_i)$ is bijective. Here the coproduct on the right is the coproduct in $C_X$, not an assertion of compactness in all of $D(\mathcal O_X)$.

source.place: Tag 09M8, proposition-compact-is-perfect, perfect-to-compact direction; perfect objects lie in D_QCoh as in section-spell-out and the first paragraph of that proof.

proof.text: Coproducts used below exist in the ambient category. By [lem-pur-ringed-site-grothendieck-abelian] module sheaves form a Grothendieck abelian category. K-injective resolutions exist by [lem-sfb-grothendieck-k-injective]. Coproducts in module sheaves are exact: they are filtered colimits of finite biproducts, so exactness follows from the Grothendieck axiom. Apply [lem-kun-grothendieck-derived-coproducts] and [src-weil-derived-homology-preserves-coproducts]: termwise sums give ambient derived coproducts and $\mathcal H^q(\bigoplus E_i)=\bigoplus\mathcal H^q(E_i)$. By [lem-sfb-space-qcoh-kernels-colimits] these sheaves are quasi-coherent when the $E_i$ lie in $C_X$. Fullness restricts the ambient coproduct universal property to $C_X$, so these are also its coproducts, with the same injections.

A perfect $P$ has quasi-coherent cohomology. Use its local bounded finite-free-retract models [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package]. On each etale chart, finite free structure modules are quasi-coherent by their presentations [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]; a retract is the image of its splitting idempotent, so all terms of such a model are quasi-coherent by [lem-sfb-space-qcoh-kernels-colimits]. Kernels and cokernels from that same node show that $\ker d^q/\operatorname{im}d^{q-1}$ is quasi-coherent. The etale restriction and local detection in [lem-sfb-space-derived-etale-chart-calculus] now give the assertion for $P$. This argument is on each individual chart and requires no uniform local bound.

source.place: section-spell-out, local perfect models; Tag 071X and Tag 03M1

proof.text:
Set $P^\vee=R\mathcal Hom(P,\mathcal O_X)$. By [lem-sfb-ringed-site-perfect-duality] it is perfect and the evaluation comparison $P^\vee\otimes^{\mathbf L}M\cong R\mathcal Hom(P,M)$ is natural in every $M$. Use [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal] to supply the tensor-Hom adjunction required by the sections model. Taking zeroth derived sections and using [lem-sfb-derived-internal-hom-sections-model] gives a natural identification
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_X)}(P,M)\cong H^0(X,P^\vee\otimes^{\mathbf L}M).$$

source.place: Tag 09M8, proposition-compact-is-perfect, first paragraph; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 08JJ

proof.text: For $M\in C_X$, the tensor $T(M)=P^\vee\otimes^{\mathbf L}M$ lies in $C_X$ by the following finite-column argument. Restrict to an etale chart $V$ with a bounded finite-free-retract model $F$ for $P^\vee$; exact restriction and local detection are [lem-sfb-space-derived-etale-chart-calculus]. Restriction to the slice site is strong monoidal: [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-slice-normalized-comparisons] gives $T(M)|_V\cong P^\vee|_V\otimes^{\mathbf L}M|_V$. A finite-free-retract module $L$ has exact tensor functor, as a functorial direct summand of a finite power of the identity. Thus $H^q(L\otimes M)=L\otimes H^q(M)$ is a direct summand of a finite sum of quasi-coherent sheaves, hence quasi-coherent by [lem-sfb-space-qcoh-kernels-colimits]. Such $L$ is flat, and the bounded flat model $F$ is K-flat by [lem-weil-pbc-independent-bounded-flat-kflat], so its total tensor with any representative of $M$ computes $T(M)$. Filter this total complex by columns with $p\ge c$. The quotients are $(F^c\otimes M)[-c]$ and the sequences of consecutive tails are split in each degree. Their long exact cohomology sequences [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-homology-long-exact] express each middle cohomology as an extension of a cokernel by a kernel. Kernel/cokernel closure [lem-sfb-space-qcoh-kernels-colimits] and extension closure [lem-sfb-space-qcoh-extension-closed] apply. Starting with the zero tail above the highest column and decreasing $c$ through the finite support proves the claim. No bound on $M$ is needed.

source.place: Tag 08F5, lemma-quasi-coherence-tensor-product, perfect-factor local finite-complex case; Tag 09M8 first paragraph

proof.text:
Write $T(M)=P^\vee\otimes^{\mathbf L}M$. By the closed tensor-Hom adjunction and symmetry of [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal], $T$ is a left adjoint. Explicitly, for an ambient coproduct $E=\bigoplus E_i$ and any $N$,
$$\operatorname{Hom}(T(E),N)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(E,R\mathcal Hom(P^\vee,N))\cong\prod_i\operatorname{Hom}(E_i,R\mathcal Hom(P^\vee,N))\cong\prod_i\operatorname{Hom}(T(E_i),N).$$
Naturality shows that restriction along $T(\iota_i)$ gives this bijection; hence $T(E)$ with those injections is the coproduct of the $T(E_i)$. All these objects have quasi-coherent cohomology by step 4.

source.place: Tag 09M8, first paragraph: derived tensor commutes with direct sums

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-zeroth-hypercohomology-coproducts] to the coproduct cofan $T(E_i)\to T(E)$ from step 5. It identifies $\bigoplus_iH^0(X,T(E_i))$ with $H^0(X,T(E))$. Under the natural identifications of steps 3 and 4, its component on summand $i$ sends $u:P\to E_i$ to $\iota_i\circ u:P\to E$. Thus it is precisely the canonical Hom-coproduct map in the item. Fullness of $C_X$ and the coproduct identification in step 1 give the required bijection in $C_X$. The zero object and empty coproduct are covered by the same argument; no compactness assertion in the whole ambient category is made.
